title: About
intro: Hi, I'm Prakash Raj—a full-stack developer, AI enthusiast, and data scientist who enjoys turning ideas into impactful digital experiences.
description: I'm currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at ICFAI University, Jaipur. I enjoy building scalable web applications, exploring modern AI technologies, and solving real-world problems through software and data.

My work spans across full-stack development, system design, and Generative AI. I build applications using technologies like React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, and TypeScript, while also working with Python, machine learning, LangChain, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and LLM-powered applications.

Beyond coding, I'm an open-source enthusiast who believes in continuous learning and sharing knowledge with the developer community. Whether I'm designing an intuitive user experience, architecting a scalable backend, or experimenting with the latest AI tools, I'm always driven by curiosity and the desire to create software that makes a meaningful impact.
